##  **🧩 Basic Improved**
Basic Improved is a powerful client-side quality of life mod that upgrades your Minecraft experience with smooth animations, clean UI improvements, and smart interaction features — without changing vanilla gameplay mechanics.
It is designed for players who want a modern, polished, and premium feel while keeping Minecraft fully vanilla-friendly.
##  **✨ Features**
● Zoom Feature

![Zoom Feature](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a33333209ade981a9e7fba03ba4d8199f1244a4.gif)

● Better Mouse Controls

![Mouse](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09a0f01a34ce0590328ab0d1c89d69528c3b73fc.gif)

● Better Settings Panel

![panel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c98666eb4c9e7f97c00f2ab8832ad1a8c92b097.gif)

###  **🎮 Gameplay Philosophy**
Basic Improved does not change how Minecraft is played.
No cheats. No unfair advantages. No gameplay modifications.
It only improves:
Comfort
Visual smoothness
User experience
Interaction quality
Interface design

● New Crosschairs

![Cross](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ccaf1844a306576cf361582400ace442d73cac3.gif)

● Bouncing Hotbar

![hot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b36578e9914862d85b2ba945a236ea530c8de015.gif)

Lightweight mod

Works in multiplayer servers
Server-safe mod

Compatible with most mods

## **💡 Why This Mod**
Because small details matter.
Basic Improved focuses on tiny improvements that together create a big difference in how Minecraft feels.
Cleaner. Smoother. Better
Small changes. Big improvement.
Basic Improved – Upgrade your Minecraft experience.
